notes: These are authored tip records, not a replacement ventoy.json.
Exact installed image and directory paths must be reconciled before generation.
Ventoy renders menu tips on one line, so project policy limits each draft to 140 characters.

tips.pathHint: Guide Center / Start Here path pending
tips.tip: START HERE — Pick the job first. The guide routes you to the safest tool and tells you what can be skipped.
PASSWORD ACCESS — Identify local account, Microsoft account, PIN, and encryption before changing a credential.
BOOT REPAIR — Diagnose firmware, disk detection, boot mode, partition layout, and Windows boot files before writing.

tips.pathHint: Live Operating Systems directory path pending
tips.tip: LIVE SYSTEMS — Run an OS from USB for recovery or testing. A live environment can still modify internal disks.

tips.pathHint: Backup and Recovery directory path pending
tips.tip: BACKUP — First decide what must survive. Verified cloud recovery may mean a full disk image is unnecessary.
INSTALL WINDOWS — Confirm the physical target, backup, passkeys, 2FA, recovery keys, boot mode, and accepted erase scope.
